description: Says which documented FrontMCP version a project should read, and the endpoint that pins it. Pass the project's package.json, its lockfile (package-lock.json, yarn.lock or pnpm-lock.yaml, including relevant importers and all SDK resolutions), or a version range. An unambiguous lockfile identifies an installation; package.json only the range it allows. If several installations exist, select an npm/pnpm workspace or pass an exact installedVersion read from the resolved SDK package. Call it first when you can read the project.

installedVersion.description: Exact release read from this project's resolved @frontmcp/sdk/package.json. Takes precedence over a shared lockfile; never guess it from a range.

lockfile.description: The project's lockfile, including the selected importer and all SDK resolutions. A truncated fragment must preserve that context.

packageJson.description: The project's package.json, as it is.

range.description: A version or range, like "1.9.4" or "^1.9.0".

workspace.description: Workspace/importer path in an npm or pnpm lockfile, for example "." or "packages/api". Required when installations are ambiguous.

name: resolve_version
title: Find the docs version for a project
